name: SD: Kanban board (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A software team's board, every day: backlog, in development, in review, in testing, done, and open bugs, and the sprint capacity the team has left. Every card pulled into development uses up a card of the sprint's capacity (a co-flow); sprint planning sets the capacity again every two weeks, so late in a busy sprint the team stops pulling work and the backlog waits. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-kanban/truth.model.json, including a stock the board does not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
